paperTitle: TsetFall: A Comprehensive Dataset for Human Fall Detection with AI-Assisted Annotation
centralContribution: This work introduces TsetFall, a comprehensive, fine-grained, and publicly available dataset meticulously generated for human fall detection research, addressing existing dataset limitations in size, diversity, representativeness, and real-world complexity by including precise object location annotations and diverse scenarios. The dataset's annotation process was notably expedited and enhanced by a novel AI-assisted technique devised by the authors, enabling detailed object-level annotations for training and evaluating advanced computer vision algorithms.

units.title: Paper Abstract
units.summary: Summary of TsetFall dataset, addressing fall detection challenges with new data.

content.description: Human fall detection faces challenges due to limitations in current datasets, which lack size, diversity, real-world complexity, and fine-grained annotations. This scarcity impacts system performance, especially given the global aging population and high incidence of fall-related deaths. TsetFall is introduced to overcome these issues by providing a comprehensive, multi-camera, high-resolution dataset with detailed object-level annotations, including an innovative AI-assisted annotation method.

content.description: A table detailing the frame counts for each video sequence across four cameras, categorized by 'Confounding' (C), 'Fallen' (FN), 'Falling' (FG), and 'Not Fallen' (NF) classes, providing a comprehensive view of the dataset's fine-grained annotations per camera and overall frame count.

Performance metrics (mAP IOU [0.5:0.95], mAP IOU 0.5, mAP IOU 0.75, AR [20] IOU [0.5:0.95] maxDets 10) for different YOLOv8 models (YOLOv8l, YOLOv8m, YOLOv8s, YOLOv8n) when evaluated on the complete AI-assisted annotated subset of the TsetFall dataset (Camera 4).

Evaluation metrics (Sensitivity, Specificity, Geometric Mean) for the simplified 'Fall' and 'NoFall' classification task, performed by different YOLOv8 models (YOLOv8l, YOLOv8m, YOLOv8s, YOLOv8n) on the AI-assisted annotated TsetFall dataset.

A comparative table highlighting the superior features and advantages of the TsetFall dataset against other RGB fall detection datasets (Multicam Fall, UR Fall Detection, UMA Fall) across various criteria like dataset size, environment, camera viewpoints, resolution, data acquisition technology, number of falls/ADLs, fall/ADL types, and annotation details.
